card.name: The verb face and faced
card.fires_on: The verb "face" or "faced" (also the word after Face, or the start of "Faced") meaning to confront or be confronted with something, in general web prose.

modes.label: Faced with
modes.description: Passive or participle "faced" followed by "with" a choice, fact or situation.
modes.example: we are<< faced>> with a choice.

modes.label: Face as confront
modes.description: Base verb "face" after a modal or "to", meaning to confront hardship, law or danger.
modes.example: must<< face>> the full force of the law

modes.label: Name Face the Facts
modes.description: The word "the" inside the name Face the Facts.
modes.example: Face<< the>> Facts USA offers you issue briefs

card.plain: It lights up on the verb "face" when it means to confront or be confronted with a problem.
